SPAM Card Inspector est un projet indépe: SPAM Card Inspector is an independent project provided by Jo0kker. Contact:
. Il permet aux viewers sur ordinateur d: . It lets desktop viewers read the abilities of visible SPAM cards by hovering over the Twitch player.
Le streamer doit disposer du jeu SPAM su: The streamer must own SPAM on Windows, install the game module and companion, then pair their PC with their own Twitch channel. The extension must be installed and activated on that channel. The game, companion, Twitch and server must be running to provide card details. The current version is a Video Overlay for the desktop web player; it does not provide a mobile view.
L’intégration est actuellement proposée: The integration is currently provided without payment within the service. Do not share pairing codes or publishing keys. Do not use the service to access another channel’s data or settings without permission. Follow the terms of the platforms, software and content you use.
Le service est en évolution. Les fiches: The service is evolving. Details depend on the data received, the game version and the video delay; errors, delays or interruptions may occur. Report problems using the contact above. This version does not promise continuous availability or support for every version of SPAM.
Vous pouvez arrêter le compagnon, dissoc: You can stop the companion, unpair the PC and deactivate the extension on Twitch. To request deletion or revocation of pairing stored on the server, contact the provider. The game module can be removed using the procedure included with the Windows package after closing the game.
Les noms, textes et illustrations du jeu: Game names, text and artwork belong to their respective rights holders. This is a community service, affiliated with neither Ticroco nor Twitch. Le connecteur installé dans SPAM lit les: The module installed in SPAM reads cards displayed on screen. The Windows companion sends their data to the server so channel viewers can see abilities by hovering over the video. It does not send game video or audio.

Contrôler l’accès aux données et aux rég: Control access to data and settings. The app does not create persistent viewer profiles or request identity linking.
Nom de PC choisi par le streamer, identi: PC name chosen by the streamer, pairing ID and pairing date
Identifier le PC autorisé et permettre s: Identify the authorized PC and allow its access to be revoked. The name is optional; no hardware name is collected automatically. Last contacts and updates are used to display connection status.
Code d’association et clé de publication: Pairing code and channel-specific publishing key
Autoriser le compagnon à envoyer les don: Authorize the companion to send data. The server stores a hash of the key; the usable key stays on the paired PC.
Adresse IP et informations techniques de: IP address and technical information from network requests
Acheminer les connexions et limiter les: Route connections and limit pairing attempts. The app does not create an HTTP request log. The rate limiter keeps counters associated with network addresses in memory; entries are removed when the service restarts or when expired entries are cleaned up after the limiter reaches its threshold.
Répondre aux demandes et résoudre les pr: Answer requests and resolve reported problems.
Le code d’association expire au bout de: The pairing code expires after five minutes and can only be used once. The server keeps pairings and settings for subsequent connections. Starting with companion 0.3.0, “Revoke this PC’s access” revokes authorization on the server and then removes the local key; if the server is unreachable, the app indicates that revocation has not been confirmed. The new Twitch configuration panel also allows revoking the paired PC and cancelling pending codes. Pairing name, date and ID are kept with the authorization and deleted on revocation; last-contact timestamps stay in memory and are reset when the service restarts. Channel settings are retained. Older companion versions only delete their local key: their server access can be revoked from the new panel or by contacting support.
Les états du jeu ne sont pas écrits dans: The backend does not write game states to a permanent match history. They stay in an in-memory buffer limited during updates to 300 states, 8 MiB or approximately two minutes. After updates stop, the last buffer may remain in memory until updates resume or the server restarts. Revoking access or replacing a PC immediately clears this buffer. Support exchanges are kept for the time needed to handle the request.
Les viewers autorisés de la chaîne reçoi: Authorized channel viewers receive the data needed for card details. The provider and its technical service providers may access data to operate the service or respond to a request. Twitch supplies the player, extension file hosting and authorizations. Its own processing is governed by its privacy policy.
